selection: pre-existing deterministic task index 4 (paraphrase), eight preselected cases; same cases in both arms; no redraw
protocol: Compile separate binary and semantic-unsure programs for the same task before evaluating. Binary labels PARAPHRASE and NOT_PARAPHRASE; semantic labels PARAPHRASE, NOT_PARAPHRASE, UNSURE. Record native two-label-normalized first-token confidence: take the maximum logit within each label space/no-space token variants, then apply a two-label softmax; retain token IDs, logits, and raw outputs, all invalid, unfinished, missing and model identities. Each case once per arm; no forced abstention. Threshold probability on binary output at 0.60,0.70,0.80,0.90,0.95,0.99.
rule: TRANSFER_SUPPORTED iff all 16 arm/case observations complete, semantic invalid count zero, semantic decided count >= 6 of 8 and semantic decided exact-match accuracy >= 0.90; semantic unsure rate <= 0.25. Otherwise TRANSFER_NOT_SHOWN if observations complete, INCOMPLETE if any missing. Separately report binary threshold coverage and accuracy; no asserted threshold superiority on n=8. Higher decided accuracy is better; lower unsure rate is better.
